text: AgiBot X2 Ultra, the same model files for every track.
Two apparatuses: ours (the IEEE loco-manipulation apparatus, from the CAD) and the NIST one. Neither goes into training as a whole; only separate, re-arranged parts may.
Door, 4x4 stepovers, buttons 1-2, crossing ramps, buttons 3-4, wall, stairs, landing, button 5.
One robot, one attempt at the whole route, commands produced from the waypoints only. No reference motion replay.
Reaches the last waypoint within the time limit without a fall and without leaving the course. Also reported per section (door, 4x4s, ramps, stairs), with time and foot-contact quality.
status: Time limit and button rule open

text: At least 200 trials per checkpoint with randomised start pose and physics, same seeds for every track. A 99% claim needs at least 500 trials; the final claim uses 1,000.
Each track's training simulator plus MuJoCo as the common cross-check. A number counts only if it holds in MuJoCo too.
